items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: when I got there Papa said Lizzy Miles huh I said that's right he said uh would you like to talk? I said let's go and we started talking

ctx.x: well how did you get on Papa Stopper's program?

well I think it's by the letter that I wrote him you see about the why about the singing yeah somebody mustn't sing just jive talk to get me for his singing so he had to come on the program I think it's him that gave my telephone number to Mr. Joe Maurez so Mr. Joe Maurez is the one who called me up and he says you Leslie Miles? I said yes he said well I got a record here of yours and I'd like to hear you sing he said would you like to come on Papa Stopper's program I said sure he said well alright come up and he…
did you ever get that case of line?
